mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( (SELECT FROM poi_bank WHERE id = #{id}) UNION ALL (SELECT FROM poi_community WHERE id = #{id}) ) poi_all LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT district) FROM ( (SELECT district FROM poi_bank WHERE status <> 'closed') UNION ALL (SELECT district FROM poi_community WHERE status <> 'closed') ) d
SELECT brand AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM poi_bank WHERE status <> 'closed' AND brand IS NOT NULL AND brand <> '' GROUP BY brand ORDER BY value DESC, label LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN avg_price < 50000 THEN '< 5 万' WHEN avg_price < 70000 THEN '5–7 万' WHEN avg_price < 90000 THEN '7–9 万' WHEN avg_price < 110000 THEN '9–11 万' ELSE '≥ 11 万' END AS label FROM poi_community WHERE status <> 'closed' AND avg_price_source = 'gov_reference' AND avg_price IS NOT NULL ) t GROUP BY label
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN avg_price_source = 'gov_reference' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS real_count FROM poi_community WHERE status <> 'closed'
SELECT FLOOR(lng / 0.02) AS gx, FLOOR(lat / 0.02) AS gy, COUNT(*) AS value FROM poi_bank WHERE status <> 'closed' GROUP BY gx, gy ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT type, COALESCE(branch_type, '') AS branchType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ( (SELECT 'bank' AS type, branch_type FROM poi_bank WHERE status <> 'closed') UNION ALL (SELECT 'community' AS type, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(16)) AS branch_type FROM poi_community WHERE status <> 'closed') ) t GROUP BY type, branch_type

SELECT *, ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(lng, lat), POINT(#{lng}, #{lat})) AS distance FROM poi_community WHERE status <> 'closed' AND lat BETWEEN #{lat} - #{radius} / 111000.0 AND #{lat} + #{radius} / 111000.0 AND lng BETWEEN #{lng} - #{radius} / (111000.0 * COS(RADIANS(#{lat}))) AND #{lng} + #{radius} / (111000.0 * COS(RADIANS(#{lat}))) AND ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(lng, lat), POINT(#{lng}, #{lat})) <= #{radius} ORDER BY distance LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT district AS label, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'bank' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bank, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'community' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS community FROM ( (SELECT 'bank' AS type, district FROM poi_bank WHERE status <> 'closed') UNION ALL (SELECT 'community' AS type, district FROM poi_community WHERE status <> 'closed') ) t WHERE district IS NOT NULL AND district <> '' GROUP BY district ORDER BY bank + community DESC
